hooks.name: company-spec-task-check
hooks.description: Company default (managed by kiro-ai-baseline). After each spec task, the agent verifies tests, guardrails, and traceability before reporting done.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Before you report it done, briefly confirm: (1) tests were added or updated for the changed behavior and you ran them; (2) no secrets, PII, or guardrail violations were introduced; (3) the task checkbox in tasks.md is updated and still references its requirement IDs. Fix anything that fails before continuing.
